calls.statement:
WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, o.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, o.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS click_collect_net,
       SUM(l.net_sales) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN l.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN l.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(l.net_sales), 1) AS click_collect_share_pct
FROM web_lines l
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 10
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1, 2

calls.statement: SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_period IN (9,10) AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2024/25','FY2025/26','FY2026/27') ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales),2) AS ctrl_net, ROUND(SUM(r.net_sales_before_returns),2) AS ctrl_before, ROUND(SUM(r.returns_net),2) AS ctrl_returns
FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.business_date
WHERE r.store_id = 900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT d.fiscal_period, s.store_id = 900 AS booked_to_web, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(SUM(r.refund_net),2) AS refund_net, SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS test_rows
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = r.return_date
WHERE f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order)
  AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2
